[ISBK.1.9] **`instance_clone` (optional, ABI v4).** Deep-copies per-key state
into `*out_state` — **verbatim**, including any PRNG state (the reservoir's
`xorshift64` seed) and every owned buffer / string — so a cloned engine's series
are exact, not cold-started ([IARC.11.2] / [LDET.2.2b]). The copy is caller-owned
and freed via `instance_free`, independently of the source; `DS_ERR_OOM` on
allocation failure leaves the source unchanged. Consumed by the engine-clone
deep-copy (the `[IARC.11.1]` deep-copy-mutable set).

**Every backend libds ships must set the hook.** The backend set is closed
([NSBK.2.3]), so no engine an integrator holds has a series that cannot be
cloned. A NULL hook is a defect in libds's own registration, and
`ds_engine_clone` refuses an engine holding a live series row on such a backend
with `DS_ERR_STATE` rather than cold-start it.
